placement: Governed Adapter — an application-owned adapter behind the existing limen.adapters contract (#30), shown as example 10: examples/10-canvas-surface. The surface owns pixels, animation frames, hit testing, device-pixel sizing, hover and its keyboard cursor; the engine owns the data, the selection and the viewport it adopts. Only a small declarative scene crosses as props, and only semantic facts come back (a selection request, a settled viewport), so rendering at frame rate sends nothing across the boundary. Focus through the focus pack; sizing is the surface's own. No new contract, no Core change, no graphics primitive anywhere in Limen.
